Metallic castanets are used both by thePersian and Beluch in the dancing, and it isusually the dancers—one or more boys—whoplay them. Many of the songs and melodies I heard inPersia reminded me very forcibly of Spanish^ melodies, which, like these, are undoubtedly ofArab origin. Whatever fault one may find with Persian orBeluch music, one cannot say that the performersdo not play with an immense deal of feeling andentrain—a quality (the primary one, to mymind,) in music often lacking in musiciansnearer home, but never in Orientals.
